note: Stationary, 15 frames, 11 tape points 0.33-3.36 m. 8 bold markers placed and taped 2026-08-04 plus 3 older thin markers proven undisturbed (cross-session drift < 3 mm). sigma read from /depth_var, converted to slant like /depth. The robot did not move; the four older markers excluded had local scene changes (a new marker on the same bottle, the operator standing in frame), not camera motion.

findings.works: sigma flags the vertically out-of-cone markers (7,8): errors 1.07 and 1.52 m carry sigma 2.10 and 1.84, both inside 1 sigma. Rank correlation +0.655 -- sigma orders the errors.
findings.not_calibrated: coverage is 0.818 at BOTH 1 and 2 sigma -- identical, so every point outside 1 sigma is also outside 2. sigma is too wide on easy points (7 of 11 have |err|/sigma < 0.35) and far too narrow on the failures. The distribution shape is wrong, not just the scale.
findings.blind_spot_mixed_return: marker 5 is off by 2.55 m with sigma 0.66 (3.9 sigma). Its zone clips a bottle 0.33 m away while the marker is on a banner 2.89 m back. This is the failure mode sigma misses completely, and it is the one that matters most for obstacle detection.
findings.axis_asymmetry: marker 1 at -47.8 deg horizontal is outside the +/-36.75 deg cone, off by 0.47 m, sigma only 0.23 (2.0 sigma). Markers outside the cone VERTICALLY got sigma > 1.8 for comparable errors. The uncertainty model treats the two axes differently.
findings.fusion_degrades_a_correct_reading: at marker 1 the ToF zone itself reads 0.72 m against a 0.736 m tape -- essentially exact -- while the fused /depth reads 1.20 m. Third independent sighting of the out-of-cone problem.
findings.instability_unmodelled: marker 7 varies 256 mm frame-to-frame against a 32 mm average. Frame-to-frame spread is a usable uncertainty signal that sigma does not currently capture.
